body: LedgerGuests.test.tsx 'stops offering another box at the server's cap' timed out at 5049ms in the release run's gate (./release.sh 4.0.0, web stage, 2026-11-01) and failed the release; it passed in every earlier gate. It clicks 'Add another' 49 times through userEvent, whose per-click delays add up under load. Make the repeated clicks synchronous (fireEvent) or raise the case's own timeout; it is not a logic bug.
title: Web test: the create-dialog guest-cap case clicks 49 times and exceeds vitest's 5s timeout under the parallel gate
